items.title: Action Menus
items.subtitle: Reorder or hide the actions in each ••• and moderator menu, with a live preview. Find it under Interface > Menus.

items.title: Smoother Video Feeds
items.subtitle: Video players get ready in the background, so video-heavy subreddits scroll without hitches.

items.title: Immersive Profiles
items.subtitle: Banner art now runs behind the bars. Long-press a banner to view it full-screen and save it.

items.title: Chat Drafts
items.subtitle: Unsent messages in modern Direct Chat are kept for each account and conversation.

items.title: Confirm Favorite Changes
items.subtitle: Have the star on the Subreddits list ask before adding or removing a favourite. Off by default.
